# CHAPTER 1 PREREQUISITES

## Try It #2

Simplify each of the following quotients as much as possible using the power of a quotient rule. Write answers with positive exponents.

a. $\left(\frac{t^2}{r}\right)$

b. $\left(\frac{z}{u^4}\right)^3$

c. $\left(\frac{-1}{w^2}\right)^4$

d. $(p^{-2}q)^3$

e. $(c^{-3}d^{-1})^2$

## Simplifying Exponential Expressions

Recall that to simplify an expression means to rewrite it by combining terms of exponents; in other words, to write the expression more simply with fewer terms. The rules for exponents apply to all rational exponents.

### Example 9 Simplifying Exponential Expressions

Simplify each expression and write the answer with positive exponents only.

a. $(6m^{n^{-1}})^3$

b. $17^{-1} \cdot 17^{-4} \cdot 17^3$

c. $\left(\frac{u^{1/3}}{v^{-1/3}}\right)^3$

d. $(-2x^{1/4})(5a^{1/2}b^{-1})$

e. $(\sqrt{2}\sqrt{2})(x\sqrt{2})^3$

f. $\frac{(3w^2)^5}{(6w^{-2})^2}$

## Solution

a. $(6m^{n^{-1}})^3 = (6)^3(m^n)^3(n^{-1})^3$

$= 6^3m^{3n}n^{-3}$

$= 216m^{3n}n^{-3}$

$= \frac{216m^{3n}}{n^3}$

The power of a product rule

The power rule

Simplify.

The negative exponent rule

b. $17^{-1} \cdot 17^{-4} \cdot 17^3 = 17^{-1-4+3}$

$= 17^{-2}$

$= \frac{1}{17^2}$ or $\frac{1}{289}$

The product rule

Simplify.

The negative exponent rule

c. $\left(\frac{u^{1/3}}{v^{-1/3}}\right)^3 = \frac{(u^{1/3})^3}{(v^{-1/3})^3}$

$= \frac{u^{1 \cdot 3}}{v^{-1 \cdot 3}}$

$= u^{-3(-1/3)}$

$= u^{-3}v$

$= \frac{v^3}{u^3}$

The power of a quotient rule

The power of a product rule

The quotient rule

Simplify.

The negative exponent rule

d. $(-2x^{1/4})(5a^{1/2}b^{-1}) = -2 \cdot 5 \cdot a^{1/2} \cdot a^{1/2} \cdot b^{-1} \cdot b^{-1}$

$= -10a^{1/2+1/2}b^{-1-1}$

$= -10ab$

Commutative and associative laws of multiplication

The product rule

Simplify.

e. $(\sqrt{2}\sqrt{2})(x\sqrt{2})^3 = (\sqrt{2})^3(\sqrt{2})^3$

$= (\sqrt{2})^3$

$= 1$

The product rule

Simplify.

The zero exponent rule

f. $\frac{(3w^2)^5}{(6w^{-2})^2} = \frac{3^5 \cdot (w^2)^5}{6^2 \cdot (w^{-2})^2}$

$= \frac{3^5w^{10}}{6^2w^{-4}}$

$= \frac{243w^{10}}{36w^{-4}}$

$= \frac{27w^{10+4}}{4}$

$= \frac{27w^{14}}{4}$

The power of a product rule

The power rule

Simplify.

The quotient rule and reduce fraction

Simplify.
